paragraphs: Check status and retrieve the result of a campaign import. Statuses: pending — import in progress; progress shows the current stage. Poll every few seconds. completed — done; result.campaign_id is the new campaign (or null if no leads survived validation/dedup — then no campaign was created). failed — see error.
